questions.stem: What is required to induce a voltage in a coil of wire?

options.text: A stationary magnet placed inside the coil
A change in the magnetic flux through the coil
A battery connected to the coil
A very large coil with many turns

questions.explanation: To induce a voltage (EMF) in a coil, there must be a change in the magnetic flux through the coil. This can be achieved by moving a magnet towards or away from the coil, or by changing the magnetic field strength. A stationary magnet produces no change in flux and therefore no induced voltage.
